tools.name: get_case_context
tools.purpose: The case as reported. Executed by the harness as step 1; not model-selectable.

status_rules.DIAGNOSIS_PROPOSED: at least one non-rejected hypothesis with cited support; valid citations; evidence_sufficiency is not 'insufficient'
status_rules.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: every selection may be null; evidence_sufficiency is not 'sufficient'
status_rules.HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED: human_review_required is true and review_reason is present
status_rules.CONTRACT_FAILURE: assigned by the harness only; no diagnosis is pretended, human review required

grounding_rules: every cited alias is an evidence alias retrieved during the run, cited once
a non-null selection needs a confidence; a null selection needs a null confidence
any selection needs at least one cited evidence item
causal_change must also be cited in evidence_ids
every hypothesis citation is also listed in evidence_ids
no internal id appears anywhere in the output

alias_constraints.properties: no order, recency, number or role is encoded; canonical ids are never shown to the model
